clauses: Each unit of calm-claim pays its holder six internal credits if the final operating mode is calm. It pays exactly zero in surge and exactly zero in offline.
Each unit of other-claim pays six internal credits in surge and exactly zero in calm. The offline amount has not been fixed and will be announced separately; do not assume it is zero.
These are per-unit terminal amounts. Calm, surge and offline exhaust the contractual payoff space. Credits are internal nonredeemable accounting units.
